data.summary:
Enterprise Cloud Transformation Specialist with over 15 years in IT and 7+ years in Microsoft Azure, combining deep technical acumen with business foresight to rearchitect legacy infrastructure into secure, scalable, and cost-efficient digital ecosystems for global enterprises, including multilateral institutions like the IMF.
Orchestrated end-to-end cloud modernization programs that delivered tangible business impact—achieving ~$100K annualized cost savings, enhancing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Secure Score by 27%, and reducing environment setup times by over 60% through intelligent automation and IaC implementation. Played a pivotal role in designing and operationalizing a cloud-native platform for IMF’s global press and data teams, integrating AI, AKS, and serverless technologies to streamline global content delivery, analytics, and deployment across 190+ economies. Recognized as a cloud reliability linchpin, leading incident command across L3 escalations, P1/P0 outages, and security breaches—delivering root-cause resolution and resilience uplift in high-pressure, zero-downtime environments. Architected secure hybrid cloud networks leveraging Azure-native constructs—VNET peering, Application Gateway, Entra ID, Private DNS, and NSGs—while aligning infrastructure blueprints with regulatory mandates and enterprise risk frameworks. Evanelized Cloud FinOps and Governance-first automation, enabling policy-as-code, auto- remediation, and sustainable cloud growth models through Terraform, GitHub Actions, Ansible, and Azure DevOps—bridging engineering precision with strategic cost leadership. Trusted by cross-functional stakeholders from CIOs to DevSecOps squads—as a transformation catalyst and cloud strategist, consistently aligning technical roadmaps with board-level KPIs and business value realization metrics.

Cloud Infrastructure Architecture & Modernization  Designed and delivered secure, scalable cloud architectures on Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS), provisioning VNETs, Subnets, Application Gateway, Load Balancers, Azure Bastion, Private DNS Zones, and Entra ID for seamless inter-environment connectivity.
Migrated multiple legacy monolithic applications into Azure-based microservices, modernizing enterprise IT infrastructure and enabling high-performance, scalable deployments aligned with business growth. Spearheaded the development of reusable infrastructure blueprints using Terraform, promoting repeatability, consistency, and policy compliance across cloud environments.

DevOps Engineering & CI/CD Automation 
Engineered enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Ansible, accelerating software delivery, minimizing human error, and enabling rapid rollbacks.
Automated provisioning and configuration of cloud-native components, reducing deployment time by over 60% and enabling infrastructure-as-code (IaC) governance. Enabled multi-environment release orchestration and blue-green deployments for mission- critical applications through modularized pipelines and secrets management integration.

Cloud Security & Governance 
Elevated Microsoft Defender for Cloud Secure Score from 58% to 85% by proactively implementing security recommendations, access policies, and posture management protocols across critical resources. Integrated IAM best practices and Zero Trust architecture using Azure Entra ID, Key Vault, and NSGs, enforcing principle-of-least-privilege across cloud resources. Built security guardrails into infrastructure pipelines using policy-as-code, minimizing drift and ensuring compliance with internal and regulatory standards.


Cost Optimization & FinOps Enablement  Delivered over $100K in annualized cloud cost savings by rightsizing compute resources, eliminating underutilized assets, and automating usage analytics and shutdown routines. Enabled proactive cost governance by integrating FinOps principles into provisioning frameworks and establishing visibility across multi-subscription Azure environments.  Worked with business and finance stakeholders to align cloud consumption with budget

forecasts and business unit chargeback models.
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) & Operations Excellence 
Acted as the L3 escalation and incident commander for all major infrastructure-related P1/P0 events—owning triage, root cause analysis (RCA), resolution, and stakeholder communication.
Developed automated recovery playbooks and alert response systems using Ansible and

Azure Monitor, significantly improving platform resilience and uptime SLAs. Integrated observability, availability metrics, and service dashboards to enhance proactive detection, capacity planning, and fault tolerance.
AI & Business Platform Enablement  Delivered cloud-native AI and automation capabilities to IMF business teams by integrating

Azure AI Studio and Cognitive Services, empowering economists, analysts, and press centers globally with intelligent applications. Built data ingestion and processing workflows using Azure Logic Apps, Function Apps, and Storage Queues to streamline document processing, notifications, and user workflows.
Cross-functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement 
Served as the single point of contact and SME for cloud readiness, infrastructure provisioning, DNS architecture, certificate management, and security compliance across business units. Collaborated with cross-functional teams including Windows/Linux admins, firewall/security groups, application developers & global delivery teams to drive unified deployment success. Played a strategic advisory role to senior stakeholders, translating architectural complexity into business value narratives and aligning cloud roadmaps with enterprise KPIs.
